blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Modern large vision-language models (LVLMs) [ 3 , 40 , 6 , 21 ] can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, enabling applications such as document understanding and multi-image question answering.
In multi-image contexts, answering an image-grounded question requires more than visual recognition: the model must first identify which image the question refers to.
We refer to this image-grounding component as in-context image retrieval .
This retrieval step gates downstream computation, since grounding the question in the wrong image conditions the answer on the wrong visual evidence.
Recent multi-image benchmarks show that model accuracy drops as the number of candidate images increases, exposing in-context image retrieval as a central behavioral bottleneck [ 41 , 39 ] .
However, they leave open how LVLMs internally perform this image selection, and which components in the model carry the image retrieval signal.

在多图像上下文中,回答一个以图像为基础的问题需要的不仅仅是视觉识别:模型必须首先识别问题所指的图像.
我们称这个图像定位组件为内文本图像检索 。
这种取回阶梯出自下游计算,因为把问题打入错误的图像会把答案建立在错误的视觉证据上.
近期多图像基准显示,模型精度会随着候选图像数量的增加而下降,将内文图像检索暴露为中心行为瓶颈[41,39].
然而,它们留下了LVLMs如何在内部执行这种图像选择,以及模型中哪些组件带有图像检索信号.

blocks.en:
Attention-pattern analysis has been a standard tool for identifying specialized heads in transformers [ 37 , 10 , 27 ] .
Recent retrieval-head analyses and attention-based VLM head analyses likewise identify heads by where they attend in the input context [ 42 , 8 , 4 ] .
This approach is intuitive and has been effective in practice: attention patterns expose which tokens or spans a head points to.
However, pointing is only one side of the attention operation.
Attention patterns do not by themselves determine what information the head writes into the residual stream.
A head’s output is the value-weighted vector produced by mixing value vectors according to its attention weights, and this output, rather than the attention pattern itself, is what downstream layers consume [ 20 ] .

近期的检索头分析和基于关注的VLM头分析同样确定了在输入语境中参与的负责人[42、8、4]。
这种方法直观,在实际中是有效的:注意模式暴露出象征或跨越头部的标志。
然而,指点只是注意行动的一面.
注意模式本身并不决定头部写入剩余流的信息.
头的输出是根据其注意分量来混合值矢量产生的值加权矢量,而这种输出,而不是注意分量图案本身,是下游地层所消耗的[20].

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that this gap between pointing and writing is especially important for in-context image retrieval in LVLMs, where retrieval is cross-modal: attention points to visual-token spans, but the value-weighted output must carry target-image information in a hidden representation used by later language-generation layers.
This creates a mismatch between pointing and writing.
A head may point cleanly to the target image without writing target-image information in a form recoverable from its output.
Conversely, output-side recoverability and attention-mass strength need not induce the same ranking.
Attention-only head discovery may fail to distinguish heads that merely point to the target image from heads that also write target-image information into the residual stream.

blocks.en:
We test this hypothesis with a two-sided analysis of head-level retrieval in LVLMs.
On the input side, we identify pointer heads using attention mass over image-token spans (§ 4 ).
On the output side, we identify writer heads by training a lightweight head-specific image retriever on each head’s value-weighted output, asking whether the target image can be identified from the information carried by that output (§ 5 ).
We then use targeted ablations to test which head population the model’s answer-generation pathway depends on.
Identifying image retrieval heads in LVLMs therefore requires combining where a head points with what it writes.

我们通过对LVLMs中头级检索的双面分析来测试这个假说.

在输出方面,我们通过在每头的值加权输出上训练一个轻量级头部特有图像检索器来识别出作者头像,询问是否能够从该输出所携带的信息中识别出目标图像(§5).
然后,我们使用有针对性的活化物来测试模型的答案生成路径所依赖的人群。
因此,在LVLMs中识别图像检索头需要将头指与所写内容相结合。

blocks.en:
To carry out this analysis, we introduce ICIR-MCQ (Figure 1 ; § 3.2 ), a controlled probe that gives each sample a clear target image while keeping the task solvable by standard LVLMs.
ICIR-MCQ is designed for controlled head-level discovery rather than as a standalone downstream benchmark; we evaluate transfer and causal relevance on Visual Haystacks [ 41 ] , a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark.
Across four LVLMs spanning two families and scales, only 35–47 of the top-100 heads under the pointer and writer criteria overlap.
Targeted set-partition ablations further show that standard multi-image inference depends primarily on this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls (§ 6 ).

blocks.en:
1. A controlled probe for head-level image retrieval. We introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe with clear target-image labels for head-level retrieval analysis. 2. Pointer heads as strong implicit image retrievers. We identify sparse pointer heads that reproduce at identical (layer, head) indices within shared LLM backbones.
A single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers like CLIP and SigLIP. 3. Writer heads via a complementary output-side criterion. This retriever-based ranking differs substantially from the attention-based pointer ranking. 4. Causal validation: retrieval heads are pointers that write. Set-partition ablations show that standard multi-image inference is most sensitive to heads selected by both criteria.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work has identified specialized transformer heads for syntax [ 37 , 10 ] , induction [ 27 ] , and long-context factual retrieval [ 42 ] .
Many of these analyses identify heads primarily from attention patterns over textual contexts.
However, attention weights alone do not determine the output of an attention layer [ 20 ] .
Our output-side analysis is aligned with broader mechanistic work that studies activations, circuits, and interventions beyond raw attention patterns [ 14 , 11 , 22 , 35 , 15 , 5 ] .
We extend this perspective to cross-modal image retrieval in LVLMs, where information about the target image must be written to the residual stream rather than directly emitted as an output token.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作已经确定了用于语法的专用变压器头 [37, 10],入门 [27],并长文事实检索 [42].
其中许多分析主要从注意力模式而不是文字背景中找出头。
然而,仅关注权重并不能决定一个关注层的输出[20].
我们的输出侧分析与更广泛的机械性工作相一致,这些机械性工作研究活化、电路和超出原始注意力模式的干预[14、11、22、35、15、5]。
我们把这个视角扩展至LVLMs的跨模式图像检索,其中关于目标图像的信息必须被写入到剩余流中,而不是作为输出符直接被发布.

blocks.en:
Prior work studies how VLMs integrate visual and textual information across tokens, layers, and attention patterns [ 32 , 29 , 26 , 44 , 17 , 13 ] .
Head-level VLM studies have identified visual, OCR, and broad functional heads in single-image, rendered-text, or multimodal VQA settings [ 8 , 4 , 16 , 9 ] .
These works either focus on single-image or rendered-text settings, or assign broad functional labels rather than isolating the image-selection mechanism in natural multi-image contexts.
We study natural multi-image retrieval, and our two-sided analysis exposes a discrepancy that attention-based identification alone cannot capture: heads selected by the pointer criterion are not necessarily selected by the writer criterion.

头级VLM研究在单相图,渲染文本,或多式VQA设置[8,4,16,9]中确定了视觉,OCR,和广义功能头.
这些作品要么专注于单相图或渲染文本设置,要么指定了广义的功能标签,而不是在自然多相图背景下孤立图像选择机制.
我们研究自然多图像检索,我们的双面分析暴露出一种差异,即仅基于注意力的识别无法捕捉到:用指针标准选择的头不一定是用写作标准选择的.

blocks.en:
Recent LVLMs support interleaved text and multi-image inputs [ 3 , 40 , 6 , 21 ] , enabling evaluation over many images in context.
Multi-image benchmarks such as Visual Haystacks and MM-NIAH show that performance degrades as the number of images grows [ 41 , 39 , 33 , 34 ] , suggesting that target-image grounding is a central bottleneck.
However, they evaluate output behavior rather than the internal retrieval mechanism.
Our work addresses this gap by providing a head-level mechanistic account of in-context image retrieval, using a controlled probe (§ 3.2 ) for discovery and Visual Haystacks for transfer evaluation (§ 4.3 ).

然而,他们评价的是产出行为而不是内部检索机制.

Models. We study four LVLMs spanning two model families and two parameter scales: InternVL3.5-{4B, 8B} [ 40 ] and Qwen3-VL-{4B, 8B} [ 6 ] .
The two model families differ in vision encoder and training data, but the 4B variants share an LLM backbone, as do the 8B variants.
This design lets us examine head-level stability across LLM backbones and, within shared backbones, head-index reproducibility.
We choose these families because they are recent open-weight LVLMs that support interleaved multi-image inputs and allow head-level attention extraction and intervention.
Exact architectural dimensions and implementation details are provided in Appendix A .

两个模型家族在视觉编码器和培训数据上各有不同,但4B变体与8B变体一样共享了LLM主干.
这个设计让我们可以检查整个LLM主干网的头级稳定性,并在共享主干网内,检查头级索引的可复制性.
我们选择这些家庭是因为它们是近期的开放重量的LVLM,它们支持多图像的交互输入,并允许头级的注意力提取和干预.

blocks.en: 3.2 ICIR-MCQ: A Controlled Probe for Head-Level Image Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 ICIR-MCQ:用于头等图像检索的受控探测器

blocks.en: Figure 1 : An ICIR-MCQ sample. The model selects the caption matching the image containing the queried category ( zebra ). At the cattok , the pointer criterion ranks images by projection-based attention mass (Eq. 3 ), while the writer criterion ranks images using a retriever trained on the head output. The two criteria can disagree in the same head.
blocks.zh: 图1:ICIR-MCQ样本。 模型选择匹配包含被询问类别(斑马)的图像的字幕. 在 catok 上,指针标准按照以投影为主的注意质量(Eq. 3)来排列图像;而编目标准则使用在头部输出上训练的取回器来排列图像. 两种标准在同一个头部可以有分歧.

blocks.en:
We design ICIR-MCQ as a controlled probe for analyzing image retrieval at the attention head level.
Each sample consists of an interleaved image-text context with N N candidate images, a textual query specifying an object category, and four candidate captions.
The model is asked to select the caption that best describes the image containing the queried category (Figure 1 , top).
The target image i ⋆ i^{\star} is the unique image in the context annotated with the queried category; in Figure 1 , this is the second image, which contains a zebra and matches the caption (B).
blocks.zh:
我们设计ICIR-MCQ作为在注意力头级分析图像检索的可控探测器.
每个样本包括一个与 N 候选图像相隔的图像文本上下文,一个指定对象类别的文本查询,以及四个候选标题.
该模型被要求选择最能描述包含被询问类的图像的字幕(图1,上方).
目标图像 i i i i star } 是上下文中与被询问类别相注释的独特图像;在图1中,这是第二个图像,它包含斑马并匹配标题(B).

blocks.en:
ICIR-MCQ is constructed to satisfy three properties.
First, the input is an interleaved image-text context, matching the general form of multi-image inputs to LVLMs.
Second, the intervening text passages do not reveal the target image or the correct caption.
Third, the candidate images are natural images, so head-level findings are not tied to a synthetic visual construction.
To satisfy these requirements, we construct ICIR-MCQ from MS-COCO [ 24 ] , inheriting the interleaved structure from MM-NIAH’s image-retrieval task [ 39 ] and substituting natural images for the original images.
blocks.zh:
ICIR-MCQ的构造满足了三个属性.
首先,输入是一个互放图像-文本上下文,与LVLMs相匹配多图像输入的一般形式.
第二,中间文本段落不显示目标图像或正确的标题.
第三,候选图像是自然图像,所以头级的发现不与合成视觉构造挂钩.
为了满足这些要求,我们从MS-COCO[24]建造了ICIR-MCQ,继承了MM-NIAH的图像检索任务[39]的相接结构并取而代之的是原始图像的自然图像.

blocks.en:
More precisely, we keep the inherited text passages and reformulate the task as multiple-choice caption matching.
Because the original MM-NIAH passages are kept fixed while the images and captions are newly substituted from COCO, the passages are independent of the target image and answer options by construction.
We use COCO category annotations to control the per-image attribution target: the queried category is annotated in the target image but not in any distractor image, making the target image unambiguous given the category cue.
Distractor captions are sampled from other COCO images containing the same queried category, so the model cannot solve the task from the category cue alone; it must ground the query in the correct image.
blocks.zh:
更确切地说,我们保留了所继承的文本段落,并将任务改写为多选择标题匹配.
由于原始的MM-NIAH段落在图像和标题从COCO被新取而代之的同时被固定下来,所以这些段落独立于目标图像,通过构建解答选项.
我们使用COCO分类说明来控制每个图像的归属目标:被询问的分类在目标图像中被注释,但在任何分心者图像中都没有被注释,使得目标图像在类别提示下是清晰的.
从包含相同被询问类的其他COCO图像中抽取了discription 标题,因此模型无法单独从分类提示中解决任务;它必须将查询以正确的图像来进行.

blocks.en:
For head-level analysis, we score each head at the last token of the final mention of the queried category, which we call the cattok .
This token is a query position at which the category cue has just appeared in text and all candidate image spans are in the causal past.
In Figure 1 , the cattok is the last token of zebra in option (D).
Scoring at the cattok asks which image each head ranks highest when conditioned on the queried category.
blocks.zh:
对于头级分析,我们在每个头的最后一个符号 提到被询问的类别,我们称之为"克托克"。
此符号是一个查询位置, 分类提示刚刚在文本中出现, 所有候选图像跨度都在因果过去 。
在图一中,克托克是选项(D)中斑马的最后一个标志.
在 cattok 中, 询问每个头部在被询问类别中设置条件时排行最高的图像 。

blocks.en:
The target image position and correct answer letter are balanced uniformly across options; further sampling and filtering details are in Appendix B .
We compute head-level retrieval R@1 under each criterion’s score, defined in § 4.1 and § 5.1 .
ICIR-MCQ serves as our discovery probe and supplies the data for training and evaluating the head-specific image retrievers (§ 5.1 ).
blocks.zh:
目标图像位置和正确的回答字母在各选项之间是统一平衡的;进一步的取样和过滤细节载于附录B。
我们在每个标准分数下计算头级检索R@1,定义在§4.1和§5.1.
ICIR-MCQ作为我们的发现探测器,并提供数据用于培训和评估头部特有图像检索器(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Pointer Heads Transfer Beyond the Controlled Probe

blocks.en:
We next ask whether pointer heads discovered on ICIR-MCQ transfer to a naturalistic multi-image benchmark.
We use Visual Haystacks [ 41 ] : each example contains multiple images and a Yes/No question with an anchor object that identifies the target image and a target object whose presence in it is queried.
For example, a question may ask, “In the image that contains a sofa , is there a bottle ?”, where sofa is the anchor object and bottle is the target object.
For pointer scoring, we use the last token of the anchor-object phrase as the cattok, because this is where the model has enough information to determine which image should be retrieved.
We evaluate at haystack size N = 10 N{=}10 , where N N denotes the number of candidate images, using each head’s per-image attention mass to rank candidate images and measuring whether the top-ranked image is the target image.

例如,一个问题可能会问:“在包含沙发的图像中,是否有一瓶?”
对于指针打分,我们使用锚-对象短语的最后一个符号作为克星克,因为这就是模型有足够的信息来决定应该取回哪个图像的地方.

blocks.en:
A single attention head from an LVLM not trained with an explicit retrieval objective achieves higher per-image retrieval R@1 (Table 2 ) than standard external vision-language retrievers—CLIP [ 31 ] , SigLIP [ 43 ] , and Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B [ 23 ] .
This comparison should not be read as a controlled training-objective comparison: the internal pointer head and the external retrievers operate on different representations and conditioning signals.
Rather, it shows that the LVLM contains a highly effective context-conditioned image-selection signal in a single head.
This advantage is consistent with the internal head’s access to richer signal: external retrievers compare global image embeddings with context-free text embeddings, whereas the pointer head attends over patch-level keys in the LVLM’s own representational space using a query conditioned on the context through the cattok.
Retriever-side work continues to improve both components [ 30 , 19 ] .
Additional retriever details are provided in Appendix A .

We split ICIR-MCQ into disjoint train/evaluation subsets at the sample level.
For writer-head discovery, we evaluate Eq. 5 over a held-out image pool of 1,200 1{,}200 candidates per LVLM and compute R@1 by whether the target image ranks first.

If the causally relevant retrieval heads are those that both point to the target image and write recoverable information into the residual stream, the dominant causal contribution should lie in the overlap between the two criteria.

blocks.en:
Intervention. For each selected head ( l , h ) (l,h) , we zero the head’s output contribution before the output projection, thereby removing its additive write to the residual stream.
We use this output-side ablation because it is a stricter test of a head’s causal contribution than query-side masking used in prior retrieval-head analysis [ 42 ] : query masking perturbs where a head attends but can still leave a value-weighted output, whereas our intervention removes the selected head’s write itself.
This output-side, head-level zero-ablation is in line with the broader causal-mediation and activation-patching literature for localizing functional roles in transformers [ 36 , 25 , 38 ] .

blocks.en: 6.2 The Pointer-Writer Overlap Carries the Causal Effect
blocks.zh: 6.2 指向-威特重叠带出因果关系

blocks.en:
Ablating the pointer-writer overlap produces the most consistent accuracy drops among the tested head populations (Figure 3 ).
The effect generally grows with the ablation budget and is most visible at haystack sizes 2 2 – 20 20 , where the pointer-writer curve separates from both single-criterion tails and matched random-head controls.
At larger haystack sizes, the unablated baseline is already closer to the Yes/No chance level, leaving less room for further accuracy drops, so ablation effects are smaller.
Writer-only ablations show little consistent separation from random controls, suggesting that output-side recoverability alone does not identify the heads most relevant to standard inference in this intervention window.
Pointer-only ablations have a modest and less consistent effect, but remain weaker than the pointer-writer overlap in the averaged results for K ≥ 10 K\geq 10 .
Overall, the strongest causal evidence points to heads selected by both criteria rather than to heads selected by either criterion alone.
Per-model and per-haystack-size results are provided in Appendix I .

The separation from matched random controls, especially at moderate haystack sizes, suggests that the drop is not merely due to removing heads in this sequence region or reducing head capacity in general.
Rather, standard multi-image inference is most sensitive to the particular heads that both point to the target image and write recoverable target-image information.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Why the pointer-writer overlap matters. Pointing and writing are controlled by different parts of the attention: Q-K interactions determine where a head points, whereas the value pathway determines what information is written to the residual stream.
blocks.zh: 为什么指针写作机重叠很重要. 指向和写作由注意力的不同部分所控制:Q-K相互作用决定一个头指向何处,而值路径则决定哪些信息被写入剩余流.

blocks.en:
Our set-partition ablations show that standard multi-image inference is most sensitive to heads where both properties coincide.
Thus, image retrieval in LVLMs is not fully characterized by where a head attends; the relevant signal must also be written in a form available to downstream computation.
blocks.zh:

因此,LVLMs中的图像回取功能并不完全以头部所在为特征;相关的信号也必须以下游计算可用的形式来书写.

blocks.en:
From analysis to intervention. Our results suggest that interventions based only on amplifying attention to the target image may be insufficient when the selected heads do not write target-image information.
A possible future direction is to modify the value-side pathway of heads that already point well, for example by retraining or steering only a small set of value/output projections while leaving the rest of the model unchanged.
Such targeted interventions could test whether improving the writer side of existing pointer heads can improve multi-image inference without full-model retraining.

blocks.en:
Our analysis focuses on four recent open-weight LVLMs from two model families, and broader model coverage would further clarify how general the pointer-writer structure is.
Our naturalistic evaluation isolates single-target image retrieval in Visual Haystacks; extending the framework to cross-image comparison, multi-target grounding, and compositional reasoning is a natural direction for future work.
Complementary generation-time interventions could further characterize how retrieved visual information is converted into the final textual answer.

我们的自然主义评价隔离了Visual Haystacks的单目标图像检索;将框架扩展到跨图像比较,多目标地基,组成推理是未来工作的自然方向.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We studied in-context image retrieval in LVLMs at the attention head level.
Using ICIR-MCQ, we identified sparse pointer heads whose per-image attention mass ranks the target image first.
These heads localize to a consistent mid-block region and transfer beyond the controlled probe, providing a strong input-side retrieval signal.
However, attention mass alone is incomplete: a head selected by the pointer criterion is not necessarily selected by the writer criterion.
We therefore introduced a retriever-based output-side writer criterion and found that pointer and writer rankings identify related but distinct head sets.
Targeted set-partition ablations show that standard single-pass inference is most sensitive to heads selected by both criteria rather than to either single-criterion tail.
Together, these results support a two-sided account of image retrieval in LVLMs: our strongest causal evidence favors heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: The four LVLMs share the same language-model shape: 36 transformer blocks with 32 attention heads each, L ⋅ H = 1,152 L\cdot H=1{,}152 heads in total, and head dimension d h = 128 d_{h}=128 . Each model is loaded from its HuggingFace snapshot in bfloat16 and run with FlashAttention-2 [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 4个LVLM共用同一种语言型号:36个变压器块,每个变压器有32个注意头;L-H=1,152个L\cdot H=1{,}共152个头;头尺寸为d-h=128 d_{h}=128. 每个型号从它的HuggingFace快照被装入bfloat16并用FlashAttentent-2 [12]跑出.

blocks.en:
We register forward hooks on q_proj and k_proj of each transformer block to capture the query and key projections needed to recompute per-head attention scores during prefill, and a forward-pre-hook on o_proj to capture each head’s output (the value-weighted sum entering the output projection) for the writer probe.
For models with Grouped Query Attention [ 2 ] , we expand KV heads to match the query heads before computing per-head attention.
The pointer score (Eq. 3 ) is computed from these captured projections at the designated readout row only; the forward pass itself is unchanged.
blocks.zh:
我们在每个变压器块的 q_proj 和 k_proj 上注册前钩,以捕捉在预填时重算每头注意分数所需的查询和关键预测,并在 o_proj 上注册前钩,以捕捉每个头的输出(输入输出投影的数值加权和),用于写入探测器.
对于具有分组查询注意[2]的模型,我们扩展了KV头来与查询头相匹配,然后计算出每个头的注意力.
指针分数(Eq. 3)仅从指定的读出行的这些所捕获的预测数中计算出来;前传本身不变.

blocks.en: For each haystack size, a fixed random seed (42) controls filler-image selection and haystack shuffling, so that every model sees the same haystack composition and order.
blocks.zh: 对于每个干草堆大小,一个固定的随机种子(42个)控制着填充物-图像选择和干草堆洗涤,这样每个模型都会看到相同的干草堆组成和顺序.

blocks.en:
We fix the per-image input budget at 448 × 448 448\times 448 pixels for all four LVLMs we study so that cross-model comparisons are not confounded by input size. InternVL3.5 uses a 448 × 448 448\times 448 resize (BICUBIC) followed by ImageNet normalization, yielding 256 256 visual tokens per image (the architecture’s native per-tile budget). Qwen3-VL uses an aspect-ratio-preserving resize within a configurable pixel budget by default; we override the processor with min_pixels = max_pixels = 448 × 448 448\times 448 , which fixes the pixel budget rather than the resolution: the aspect ratio is preserved and each side is rounded to a multiple of 32 32 , giving roughly 192 192 visual tokens per image, about three quarters of InternVL3.5’s 256 256 .
The same transforms are used in baseline and ablation runs, so within-model comparisons are unaffected by the token-count difference between the two families.
blocks.zh:
我们把每个图像的输入预算固定在448×448/448\times448像素上,用于我们研究的所有四个LVLM,这样跨模型比较就不会被输入大小所混淆. InternVL3.5使用448×448 448\times 448的调整大小(BICUBIC),然后是ImageNet正常化,每个图像产生256 256个视觉符号(建筑的原生每瓦预算). Qune3-VL默认使用可配置像素预算范围内的一面-ratio-保留大小;我们用min_pixels = max_pixels = 448 × 448 448\time 448 = 448 来覆盖处理器,它决定了像素预算而不是分辨率:侧面比例被保留,每边被绕为32个倍数,每个图像大约给出192个视觉符号,大约四分之三的InternVL3.5的256 256.
相同的变换在基线和活化运行中被使用,因此模型内部的比较不受两个家族之间的符号计数差的影响.

blocks.en:
All forward passes run in bfloat16.
Decoding is greedy ( do_sample=False , num_beams=1 ) with max_new_tokens=128 , so any randomness in answers is removed.
For VHs (Yes/No format), generation stops at the first “yes” or “no” word, with no effect on parsed accuracy.
blocks.zh:
所有前行通行证均以bfloat16形式通过。
解码是贪婪( do_sample=False,num_beams=1)用max_new_tokens=128来解码,因此答案中任意的任意性都会被去掉.
对于VHs(是/没有格式),生成止于第一个“是”或“不是”字,对解析的准确性没有影响。

blocks.en:
We evaluate CLIP ViT-L/14, SigLIP so400m-patch14-384, and Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B as external retrievers on Visual Haystacks.
For CLIP and SigLIP, we follow the standard OpenAI 80-template prompt ensemble [ 31 ] : the text embedding for the anchor object is the mean of the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized embeddings of the 80 templated prompts, and the per-image score is the cosine similarity between this ensembled text embedding and the image embedding.
The anchor noun is inserted without its article, and SigLIP prompts are padded to the 64-token maximum length used in its pretraining, which its text encoder requires.
For Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B we use a natural retrieval phrasing query, “an image with {anchor}”, and score images by cosine similarity to this query embedding.
In all three retrievers we select the argmax image as the predicted target.
blocks.zh:
我们评价CLIP ViT-L/14,SigLIP so400m-patch14-384,以及Qune3-VL-Embedding-8B作为视觉海斯塔克上的外接检索器.
对于CLIP和SigLIP,我们遵循标准OpenAI 80-template的即时组合 [31]: 被锚对象所嵌入的文本是l 2\ell\% 2} - 80个模板提示的正态嵌入的平均值, 且相片分数是此相片文本嵌入和相片嵌入的相片相近性 。
锚名词被插入时没有其文章,而SigLIP提示被加到其预训中使用的64个托肯最大长度上,这是其文本编码器所需要的.
Quen3-VL-Embedding-8 (英语). B 我们使用一个自然检索的用词查询, “ 有 {anchor} 的图像 ” , 并用与此查询嵌入的同位素相似度来评分图像 。
在所有三个检索器中,我们选择了 argmax 图像作为预测的目标。

blocks.en:
For the targeted ablation experiments (§ 6 ), a forward pre-hook on o_proj zeroes the selected head’s slice of the o_proj input over the image-retrieval span: from the first token of the anchor-object phrase to the last prefill position (the target-object phrase ends the question, so the remaining covered tokens are the fixed answer-format suffix).
The first answer token is decoded from the last prefill position, where the ablation is already in effect (Appendix I.1 checks that continuing the intervention through generation does not change the conclusions).
Random selection draws K K heads uniformly from the 1,152 1{,}152 heads at the matched budget (averaged over three seeds in the set-partition ablation of § 6.1 ); the unablated baseline runs the same pipeline with no head zeroed.
blocks.zh:
对于目标放入实验(§ 6),o_proj上的一个前置前缀会将所选头部的取出o-proj的输入片段从图像回放跨度:从锚-对象短语的第一个符号到最后一个前置位置(目标-对象短语会结束问题,所以所余被覆盖的符号是固定的答案-格式后缀).
第一个答案符从最后一个已生效的预填位置解码出(附录一.1检查通过生成继续干预不会改变结论).
随机选择从对应预算的1,152 1{,} 152个头上统一抽取出 K K 头 (在第6.1节的设定分出中平均取出3个种子); 未抽取的基准运行相同的管线,没有头为零.

blocks.en:
All main-text experiments run on NVIDIA L40 GPUs (48GB VRAM).
Single-GPU inference suffices for all four LVLMs at the haystack sizes evaluated in this paper ( N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 50 } N\in\{2,3,5,10,20,50\} ).
A Visual Haystacks pass at N = 10 N{=}10 takes about 1.5 s per sample for InternVL3.5-8B and about 4 s for Qwen3-VL-8B, whose answers are longer, and head-output extraction on ICIR-MCQ about 13 s per sample; the set-partition grid of § 6 comprises about 220 cells of 1,000 samples per LVLM, on the order of a few hundred GPU-hours per LVLM.

blocks.zh: 附录B ICIR-MCQ: 其他建筑细节

blocks.en:
ICIR-MCQ is described in the main text (§ 3.2 ) and used as the head-discovery benchmark throughout § 4 and § 5 .
This appendix gives the design rationale, the sampling procedure, the split sizes, and one abridged prompt.
blocks.zh:
ICIR-MCQ在正文中被描述(§3.2)并在整个§4和§5中作为头部发现基准被使用.
本附录给出了设计原理,采样程序,分出大小,以及一个缩略的快取.

blocks.en:
Three properties matter for head-level attribution.
First, the answer is a single discrete token whose correctness is unambiguous.
Second, all four caption options mention the queried category (the three distractor options are captions of other images of that category), so the answer cannot be identified from the category cue alone; the distractor images are drawn from other categories, so the target image is unambiguous given the cue.
Third, the small candidate set ( N ≤ 6 N\leq 6 ) keeps the head-level R@1 estimator stable at the 6,000-sample scale, allowing a full sweep of all L ⋅ H = 1,152 L\cdot H{=}1{,}152 heads without budgeted subsetting.
blocks.zh:
3个属性对头级归属很重要.
首先,答案是单一的离散符号,其正确性是明确的。
其次,所有四个标题选项都提到了被询问类别(三个分光器选项是该类别的其它图像的字幕),因此单从分类提示中无法识别答案;分光器图像取自其他类别,因此目标图像在提示中是明确的.
第三,小候选人组合(N 6 N\leq 6 )保持了头级R@1评价器在6000-样本比例上的稳定,允许全扫L = 1 152 L\cdot HQQQ 1{,} 152 个头没有编入预算的子设置.

blocks.en:
We draw each sample by (i) selecting a target image and one of its own COCO captions that mentions the queried category (sampling from the union of the MS-COCO 2017 train and validation splits), (ii) selecting N choices − 1 N_{\text{choices}}-1 distractor images from other COCO categories, excluding any image annotated with the target’s category, so that the queried category is annotated in the target image alone, and (iii) constructing a four-way multiple choice over caption options A–D, in which one option is the target’s own caption and the other three are captions of other images of the queried category, so that all four options mention the category.
We constrain (a) the target image’s position among the N choices N_{\text{choices}} images to be uniform across the N choices N_{\text{choices}} slots, and (b) the answer letter (the slot of the target’s caption among the four options A–D) to be uniformly distributed across { \{ A, B, C, D } \} .
The number of MCQ option letters (always four) is independent of N choices N_{\text{choices}} ; the candidate images themselves are unlabeled and identified by their position in the prompt rather than by a letter.

blocks.en: Appendix D Writer probe: training details and extended agreement analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 作家探测器:培训细节和扩展协议分析

blocks.en: This appendix gives the training details of the writer probe (§ 5 ) and compares the writer and pointer rankings; Appendices E and G report control experiments on the candidate pool, on object regions, and on the readout position.
blocks.zh: 本附录提供编剧探测器的训练细节(§5)并比较了编剧和指针排名; 附录E和G报告在候选池上,物体区域上,以及读取位置上进行控制实验.

blocks.en:
For each attention head, we treat its attention-value-weighted output at the query position as a d h d_{h} -dimensional image embedding and train a small head-level projection with a contrastive (InfoNCE-style) objective using ICIR-MCQ as positive-negative pairs.
Reading head-level representations through a small trained probe follows the inference-time-intervention [ 22 ] and function-vector [ 35 ] setups; we adapt the construction to a cross-modal retrieval objective.
The probe projects the head’s output and the candidate image embedding into a shared 256 256 -dimensional space through one linear layer each, followed by L2 normalization, and scores candidates by dot product.
We selected this configuration (one projector layer, L2 normalization, batch 256, learning rate × 10 − 3 1\!\times\!10^{-3} ) from a sweep over architecture, projector depth, batch size, learning rate, and normalization on the 1,200-example evaluation split used for checkpoint selection and the reported ranking; the Qwen3-VL-8B probe uses batch 128.
The LVLM weights are not modified; only the head-level probe is trained.
blocks.zh:
对于每个关注头,我们将其在查询位置的注意值加权输出作为d h d_{h}-维图像嵌入并训练出一个用ICIR-MCQ作为正负对的对比(InfonCE-tyle)目标来进行小头级投影.
通过训练有素的小型探测器读取头级表述,遵循推断-时-干预[22]和函数-向导[35]的设置;我们根据跨模式检索目标调整了构造。
探测器通过一个线性层将头部的输出和候选图像嵌入一个共享的256 256维空间,然后是L2正常化,然后通过点产品对候选者进行分分.
我们选择了这种配置(一个投影仪层,L2正常化,第256批,学习率×10−3 1\!\times\!10×3),从对建筑,投影仪深度,分批大小,学习率,以及用于检查点选择和上报排名的1200例评价分级的正常化;Qune3-VL-8B探测器使用第128批.
LVLM重量没有被修改;只有头级探测器经过了训练.

blocks.en: E.1 Object regions instead of full images

blocks.en:
The writer probe (§ 5 ) retrieves the embedding of the whole target image, so a head could in principle rank well by carrying global image identity rather than information about the queried object.
We therefore retrained the per-head retriever with the target represented by the embedding of the object region, the COCO box of the queried category inside the target image, with the probe configuration of Appendix D .
As a control for training variance we also retrained the full-image probe once more under the same settings (matched control).
Table 7 compares the resulting head rankings with the full-image writer ranking of the main text, and reports a same-category retrieval test in which the candidate pool contains only object regions of the queried category taken from other images, so that category identity alone cannot solve the task; for a query with m i m_{i} same-category distractor regions chance is 1 / ( m i + 1 ) 1/(m_{i}+1) , averaged over queries.

blocks.en: Appendix F Where Writer-Only Heads Get Their Information
blocks.zh: 附录F 仅限作家标题获得其信息的地方

blocks.en:
Writer-only heads are a relative partition: heads in the writer top-100 but outside the pointer top-100 (§ 6.1 ).
The probe recovers the target image from their outputs although they fall outside the pointer top-100, which raises the question of where that information comes from: from the target-image tokens themselves, or relayed through text positions.
Following Eq. 4 , we decompose each writer-only head’s output at the cattok into the contributions of four source groups: target-image tokens, distractor-image tokens, interleaved filler passages, and the remaining question and option tokens.
We then apply the writer probe of § 5 , unchanged, to the output reconstructed from one source group alone or with one group removed, and report the mean writer R@1 over the writer-only heads of each model (Table 9 ).
Because the probe and the cosine ranking are nonlinear, a single source can score slightly above the full output; the rows are sufficiency and removal tests, not an additive decomposition.
The two removal rows carry 95% confidence intervals from 5,000 paired head-bootstrap resamples within each model’s writer-only set; both exclude zero in every model.
blocks.zh:
只写字头是一个相对分区:在写字机上-100但指针上-100以外的头(§ 6.1).
探测器从它们的输出中取回目标图像,尽管它们位于指针上-100之外,这就提出了这种信息来自何处的问题:从目标-图像符号本身取出,或者通过文本位置来转发.
在Eq. 4之后,我们将每个只写字头在克托克的输出分解成四个源组的贡献:目标-图像符号,分心-图像符号,互放填充符段落,以及剩下的问题和选项符号.
然后,我们将§ 5的编剧探测器(不变)应用于单个来源组或移除一个来源组后重建的输出,并报告每个模型中仅由编剧组成的头的正写作者R@1(表9)。
由于探测器和余弦排位是非线性的,一个单一来源的得分可以略高于全输出;行是充足和去除测试,而不是添加剂分解.
两条取出行的置信间隔为95%,从每套模型中5,000个对齐的头-波斯特拉(book-bootstrap)再印出;两者均排除了每套模型中的零.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Writer R@1 of writer-only heads (mean over the set) when the head output is reconstructed from one source group or with one group removed. The two removal rows give the change relative to the full output, with its 95% bootstrap CI beneath. Text tokens are the interleaved filler passages plus the question and option tokens (including special tokens).
blocks.zh: 表9:当头部输出从一个源组重建或一个组被去除时,只写出头的 Writer R@1(在设定上是平均值). 两个去除行给出了相对于全输出的变化,其下方为95%的靴子CI. 文本符是互放的填充符段落外加问题和选项符(包括特殊符).

blocks.en:
The target-image tokens alone retain a writer R@1 comparable to the full output, and removing them causes the largest drop in every model.
Text tokens alone stay well below the full output, and removing all text costs much less than removing the target-image tokens; interleaved filler and distractor-image tokens alone carry almost nothing.
Text therefore provides secondary information, but a relay through text positions is not required for the target-image information that the probe recovers.
blocks.zh:
目标-图像符号单保留一个可以与全部输出相媲美的写作机R@1,去掉它们会导致每个模型中最大的下降.
单是文本符号就远远低于全部输出,去掉所有文本的成本远低于去去掉目标图像符号;单是互放填充符和分心图像符号就几乎什么也没有.
因此,文本提供了次级信息,但探测器回收的目标图像信息不需要通过文本位置进行中继.

blocks.en:
The attention patterns point in the same direction.
At the cattok and at positions + 1 +1 to + 4 +4 , writer-only heads place 2.1 to 4.0 times as much attention mass on the target image as layer-matched random heads, while their attention to the interleaved filler is below that of random heads (0.74 to 0.89 times).
Nor do they become strong pointers at a neighboring position: across + 1 +1 to + 4 +4 the median pointer rank of writer-only heads stays above 200 of 1,152, and at none of these positions in any model do more than 12 of them enter the pointer top-100.
Attention magnitude alone also does not determine output content: among heads with similar pointer R@1 (0.30 to 0.40), writer R@1 differs by 4.0 to 4.2 times between the 10th and 90th percentiles, consistent with Eq. 4 , in which attention weights set how sources are mixed while the value pathway sets what the mixture carries [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
注意模式指向同一个方向.
在克托克和位置+1+1到+4+4时,只用写作头在目标图像上将2.1到4.0的注意力质量放在与地层相匹配的随机头上,而他们对相间叶填充器的注意力低于随机头(0.74到0.89倍).
它们也不成为相邻位置的强指: 跨越+1+1到+4+4,只写作头的中指级别会停留在1,152分的200分以上,在任何型号中,这些位置都没有超过12分进入指针上-100分.
注意分量本身也不决定输出内容:在指针相近的R@1(0.30至0.40)头部中,写作机R@1在10至90百分位之间相差4.0至4.2倍,与Eq. 4一致,其中注意分量设定了来源的混合方式而值路径设定了混合物所携带的[20].

blocks.en:
The decomposition localizes the source positions of the current head’s output; it does not say how the target-image-token representations formed in earlier layers.
Writer R@1 measures probe recoverability, not downstream use: writer-only ablations remain near the matched-budget random-head controls (§ 6.1 , Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
分解会将当前头部输出的源位置本地化;它没有说目标-图像-托克表达法如何在更早的层中形成.
Writer R@1 度量衡探究可回收性,而非下游使用:仅用writer-bloods仍然靠近相匹配的预算随机头控制(§ 6.1,附录一.).

blocks.en: Appendix G Readout Position: Both Signals Are Anchored at the Cattok
blocks.zh: 附录G 位置: 两个信号都在 Cattok 被安可

blocks.en:
The pointer and writer criteria are read at the cattok, the last token of the queried-category mention (§ 3.2 ).
This appendix checks how much of each signal survives when the readout moves to later positions: the four tokens following the cattok ( + 1 +1 to + 4 +4 ), the token midway between the cattok and the end of the prompt (mid), and the last prefill token (last).
The pointer ranking is recomputed at every position from the attention mass of that position over each image span (Eq. 3 ) on the 6,000 ICIR-MCQ samples.
The writer probes are retrained independently at each position ( + 1 +1 , + 2 +2 , + 4 +4 , mid, last) with the configuration of Appendix D ; a probe retrained at the cattok itself reproduces the cattok writer ranking at Spearman ρ = 0.993 \rho=0.993 on every model, which serves as the reference for retraining variability.
Table 10 reports, for each position, the Spearman correlation of the full 1,152-head ranking with the cattok ranking together with the top-100 overlap, and the retained signal of the head sets fixed at the cattok: the mean R@1 of the cattok pointer top-100 (writer top-100) at that position divided by its value at the cattok.
blocks.zh:
指针和写作标准在被询问类别提及(第3.2节)的最后一个符号-cottok读取。
本附录检查每个信号在读出后移动到后期位置时存活了多少:活塞后的四个符号(+ 1+1到+ 4+4),活塞后到活塞后到活塞后端(中间)之间的符号,以及最后一个预填符号(上).
在6 000个ICIR-MCQ样本上,在图像跨度(Eq. 3)上从该位置的注意力质量中重新计算出指针排名。
编剧探测器在每个位置(+ 1 + 1,+ 2 + 2,+ 4 + 4,中,上)独立再训练,配置为附录 D;一个在克托克本身再训练的探测器复制克托克编剧排名为 Spearman ^ = 0.993\rho = 0.993 在每一种模式上,这可作为再培训可变性的参考。
表10报告,每个位置的Spearman与Cattok排行榜完全1,152-头排名的关联性与上-100相接重叠,并保留了在Cattok固定的头集的信号:该位置上Cattok指针上-100(写作机上-100)的平均R@1(写作机上-100)除以其在Cattok的值.

blocks.en:
Both rankings stay close to their cattok version at the local positions and at mid: pointer ρ \rho 0.939–0.961 with top-100 overlap 72–87, writer ρ \rho 0.79–0.88, and the top-1 pointer head is unchanged at every local position in every model.
The fixed sets keep a substantial fraction of their signal there: at + 1 +1 to + 4 +4 the pointer set retains 0.77–0.86 of its cattok R@1 and the writer set 0.44–0.73.
At the last prefill token both rankings move further from the cattok ranking (pointer ρ \rho 0.68–0.74, writer ρ \rho 0.54–0.73), but both signals remain measurable.

blocks.en: I.1 Prefill-only versus full-generation intervention
blocks.zh: 一.1 预填与全代干预

blocks.en:
The ablations above stop at the last prefill position, so the first Yes/No logit already reflects the intervention while the generated tokens are untouched (Appendix A ).
To check that stopping at the prefill does not change the conclusions, we re-ran the three arms and the three random controls at N = 10 N=10 , K = 30 K=30 with the zeroing continued through every generated token, and compared the two runs sample by sample (Table 12 ).
For both InternVL models, which answer with a single word, no prediction changes.
For the Qwen3-VL models, whose answers can run to a full sentence (mostly on the 8B model), continuing the intervention touches tokens after the decision and changes at most 5.1% of parsed answers, moving accuracy by at most 0.9 points without changing the ordering of the arms.
blocks.zh:
上面的擦拭在最后的预填位置上停止,所以第一个是/否日志已经反映了在生成的符号未被触及的情况下的干预(附录A.).
为了检查在预填时停放并不改变结论,我们以N=10 N=10,K=30 K=30的任意控制重新排出三只臂和三只随机控制,并且通过每一个生成的符号继续进行零化,并按样本比较这两个运行样本(表12).
对于两个InternVL模型,用一个单词回答,没有预测变化.
对于Qwen3-VL模型,其答案可以跑到一个完整的句子上(主要是在8B模型上),在决定后继续干预会触动活符并被最多5.1%被解析的答案所改变,在最多0.9点移动精度而不改变手臂的顺序.

blocks.en: J.1 Discovery on three further models
blocks.zh: 第J.1节 关于另外三个模型的发现

blocks.en:
We applied the pointer and writer criteria, unchanged, to three additional LVLMs: LLaVA-OneVision-7B [ 21 ] (Qwen2 backbone, SigLIP vision tower), Pixtral-12B [ 1 ] (Mistral-Nemo backbone, Pixtral vision encoder), and InternVL3.5-14B [ 40 ] (a larger member of the InternVL family).

blocks.en: Appendix K Visual vs. Text Retrieval Heads
blocks.zh: 附录 K 视觉对文本检索头

blocks.en:
We examined whether the image retrieval heads of Qwen3-VL-8B also serve text retrieval, using a text needle-in-a-haystack task: a numeric needle is embedded in a long interleaved image-text context (the images are filler and none is a retrieval target), and the model is asked to return the number.
Baseline accuracy is 100 % 100\% on the 291 samples, so head-level differences reflect attention behavior rather than task difficulty; we rank all 1,152 heads by their mean attention mass on the needle tokens at the position where the answer is generated.
The two probes are not matched (see below), so we read the result as suggestive only.
Table 15 shows selected heads and their ranks in image versus text retrieval.

基线精度在291个样本上为100%100QQ,所以头级差异反映了注意力行为而非任务难度;我们用在答案生成位置的针形符上的平均注意力质量来排列所有1,152个头.
这两个探测器不匹配(见下文),所以我们只将结果读作暗示.

blocks.en:
The top image retrieval head ranks 118th for text retrieval and the top text retrieval head ranks 137th for image retrieval; no head is in the top 10 for both.
The pointer cluster sits in layers 19–23, whereas the two strongest text retrieval heads sit at layer 29 and the text top-10 spans layers 23–32.

blocks.en:
The two probes differ in candidate granularity (image spans of hundreds of patch tokens versus a few-token needle), in the scoring rule (argmax of attention mass over image spans versus attention to the needle position), in task format, and in query position (the cattok versus the answer position), any of which can move a head’s rank for reasons unrelated to modality.
We therefore take the result as evidence that the two retrieval functions are not served by the same top-ranked heads in this network, and leave a matched probe to future work.

blocks.en: Appendix L Extended Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录L 扩展 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Head-level roles that recur across independently trained models are more plausibly a property of the architecture and of multi-image training than a per-model artifact: InternVL3.5 and Qwen3-VL are trained by different organizations on different data mixtures, yet the pointer cluster occupies the same mid-block layers of the same 36-block shape on all four models (Appendix C ).
This mid-block position matches where language-only transformers implement retrieval and factual lookup [ 42 , 15 ] , which suggests that the pointer-writer cluster is the multimodal analogue at the same structural position; we do not distinguish between these explanations.
blocks.zh:
跨独立训练的模型反复出现的头级角色,比每个模型的文物更合理地说是建筑和多图像训练的属性: InternVL3.5和Qune3-VL由不同的组织就不同的数据混合物进行训练,而指针集群则在所有四个模型上占据了相同的36个块形状的中层(附录C.
这个中块位置匹配了只使用语言的变压器执行检索和事实取景[42,15],这说明指针写入器集群是同一结构位置的多模式模拟;我们没有区分这些解释.

blocks.en: Wu et al. [42] identified retrieval heads in text-only LLMs by an attention-pattern criterion.

blocks.en: We expect input-side selection vs. output-side encoding to be a useful axis for revisiting text retrieval heads in long-context QA, but leave that to future work.
